subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt, replace, or close the open fork PR that claims to fix this Copilot `auth.order` bug?
rationale: The source bug is still present, but a conflicting fork PR already claims the fix, so automated cleanup should not queue a second repair before maintainers choose the candidate path.

options.title: Replace or adopt the fork PR
options.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context, then land a narrow same-repo fix if the fork branch cannot be refreshed cleanly.

options.title: Refresh the fork PR
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and provide current proof if maintainers want to keep that branch as the landing candidate.

options.title: Close the fork PR first
options.body: Close the fork PR as no longer viable before queueing a fresh repair lane for this issue.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the fork PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing fork PR as source context, then land a narrow same-repo fix if the fork branch cannot be refreshed cleanly.
